notes: No public absconder / proclaimed-offender list found for Bangalore City as of 2026-05. Karnataka State Police does maintain a 'Wanted' index page, but it links to only three PDFs (Lookout Notice - CCB, Telangana State Wanted, Ballari Dist Wanted) - none of which are a Bangalore-specific absconder roster. Bangalore City Police releases occasional wanted-criminal photos via press / Twitter but no stable URL. Sources checked: (1) https://ksp.karnataka.gov.in/new-page/Wanted/en - last update 03-07-2024, no Bangalore absconder PDF. (2) https://ksp.karnataka.gov.in/english - landing page links to a legacy 'wantedperson.aspx' DB at www.ksp.gov.in which currently refuses connections (ECONNREFUSED). (3) https://bcp.karnataka.gov.in/english (Bengaluru City Police) - 500 error on root, no absconder section in sitemap. (4) https://bcp.karnataka.gov.in/9/city-crime-record-bureau/en - City Crime Record Bureau page describes data-maintenance functions but publishes no list. (5) https://policeseva.ksp.gov.in/ - citizen services portal, TLS-cert error, no absconder section indexed.
